about: Things placed through layout data, each of a kind (src/app/94-garden-zz-7act-0kinds.js GARDEN_KINDS) that brings its own moves and pet behaviours. Not part of the saved-world identity. A row: id, kind, x and y (the foot's middle, in cells) or on (a fixed thing's id) with at [dx, dy] cells from that thing's foot middle; optional w, h, front (degrees the front faces, 90 = towards you), season, level, drawn (false: a painter draws it). A region file (assets/garden/vale-<region>.json) may carry its own `things` array the same way. Check them with: node tools/affordance-audit.mjs
